# Vaelspire — Open-Core Rust Identity & Auth Platform by Neotales

> Ultra-lightweight Rust identity & authentication platform: 9 MIT Open-Core embeddable crates + single-binary OIDC 1.0 IdP / `/forward-auth` / SCIM 2.0 / embedded SvelteKit UI server + isolated Enterprise workspace (offline Ed25519 licensing, WORM hash-chained audit storage, SIEM/OTLP telemetry, multi-region residency).
